title: cystopteris fragilis var. canariensis
intro:
Cystopteris fragilis var. canariensis, commonly known as Canary Island fragile fern, is a type of fern species found in the Canary Islands, known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties.

It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris fragilis var. canariensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
